title: Roasted butternut squash soup with blue cheese toasts
blurb: A smooth, warming soup made from roasted squash with garlic, served alongside toasted sourdough topped with melted blue cheese.
steps: Heat your oven to 200°C. Peel the butternut squash, remove the seeds and cut the flesh into roughly 3cm chunks.

Place the squash and unpeeled garlic clove on a baking tray, drizzle with half the olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Roast for 35 minutes until the squash is soft and starting to caramelise at the edges.
Dissolve the stock cube in 400ml boiling water. Squeeze the roasted garlic from its skin and add to a blender with the roasted squash and stock.
Blend until completely smooth, adding a splash more water if needed to reach your preferred consistency. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Slice the sourdough and toast until golden. Crumble the blue cheese on top and place under a hot grill for 2 minutes until the cheese melts.
Pour the soup into a bowl, drizzle with the remaining olive oil and serve with the blue cheese toasts on the side.
